vis.alt: Male hypothalamic pituitary gonadal axis: GnRH drives LH and FSH; LH stimulates Leydig cells to make testosterone, FSH acts on Sertoli cells to support spermatogenesis and inhibin B; testosterone feeds back on the hypothalamus and pituitary and inhibin B on FSH.
vis.caption: LH to Leydig to testosterone; FSH to Sertoli to sperm and inhibin B.

vis.alt: Neural control of erection and ejaculation: parasympathetic S2 to S4 nerves release nitric oxide raising cGMP and relaxing corporal smooth muscle for erection; PDE5 inhibitors prolong cGMP; sympathetic T11 to L2 drives emission and somatic pudendal fibres drive ejaculation.
vis.caption: Parasympathetic: point (erection). Sympathetic: shoot (emission). PDE5 inhibitors need nitric oxide, so nitrates are forbidden.
